Inside the building, the agent must locate the jukebox in an intermediate room. Beyond the jukebox room lies a bedroom containing the yellow_bed that must be mined. Each task naturally leads to the next: the banner guides the agent to enter the structure, the jukebox is found while exploring inside, and the bed is in the deepest room. This creates a coherent multi-hop exploration task requiring sequential discovery.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the red wall banners above the entrance. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk up close to the entrance (spawn is ~6.3 blocks from the target midpoint, so the player must move forward at least 1-2 blocks). facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking toward the banners rather than away. Target is the midpoint between the two banners at spawn-relative (2, 2, -6).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate through the first room and into or near the middle room to visually locate the jukebox. max_distance=8 requires the player to be well inside the building (the jukebox at z=-15 is 15 blocks from spawn, so the player must be at least at z=-7 to be within 8 blocks). facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the jukebox. This cannot trigger from outside the building since the entrance is at z=-6.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task — the mined item ends up in the player's inventory. Yellow beds break instantly by hand (no tool required) and drop as a 'yellow_bed' item. The player must navigate to the back room, break the bed, and pick up the drop. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the drop reliably enters inventory.

scene_description: A stone brick building with three sequential rooms. The entrance is marked by two red wall banners. The first room is an entry hall, the middle room contains a jukebox, and the back room contains a yellow bed. Rooms are separated by stone brick walls with 3-block-wide doorways for easy navigation. Wall torches provide lighting throughout.
task_text: Find the building entrance marked by red banners, enter and locate the jukebox in the middle room, then continue to the back room and mine the yellow bed.
design_notes: Player spawns at ~0,~1,~0 facing south (yaw=180). Building front wall at z=-6, back wall at z=-22. Room 1 (entry): z=-7 to z=-12. Room divider 1: z=-13 with 3-wide doorway. Room 2 (jukebox): z=-14 to z=-17, jukebox at (2,0,-15). Room divider 2: z=-18 with 3-wide doorway. Room 3 (bedroom): z=-19 to z=-21, yellow bed at (2,0,-20) head / (2,0,-19) foot. Red wall banners at (1,2,-6) and (3,2,-6) facing north above the entrance. Oak plank path at entrance level (z=-5 to z=-6) prevents step-up issues.
